Results.Query: Why did the production deployment fail?

Top5.Content: The production service would not boot because the operating system crypto dependency was absent. Adding the OpenSSL runtime package restored successful launches.
The production release could not complete because the database schema upgrade ran longer than the permitted execution period. The team restored the previous application version.
